posts.preview: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Gender Equality, Health and Social Welfare is conducting an oversight mission in the Ohangwena and Omusati regions under the leadership of Hon. Ephraim Tuhadeleni Nekongo, Deputy Chairperson

The mission assesses HIV, SRHR, and GBV services for adolescents and young people, identifies barriers such as stigma and discrimination, and aims to strengthen parliamentary oversight to improve equitable, youth-friendly healthcare in Namibia
